description: This file contains shell script code for testing fetch operations with oddly-named refs in a Git repository. It sets up test repositories, performs operations such as creating references with long or unusual names, and verifies fetch and push behaviors related to these references.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the provided commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit in the repository.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites for subsequent tests based on previous results.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
